232	def run_tf(tf, rules_all, results):
233	    t0 = time.time()
234	    rules = rules_all[tf]
235	    T, T0 = H.load(tf), H.load(tf, "L0")
236	    log(f"[{tf}] L1 units {T.n} (IS {T.is_mask.sum()}), L0 {T0.n} (IS {T0.is_mask.sum()}); {len(rules)} round-0 rules")
237	    sup = support(T, T0, rules, tf)
238	    json.dump(sup, open(os.path.join(HERE, f"support_{tf}.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=1)
239	    log(f"[{tf}] support (label-free): " + ", ".join(f"{r['id']} {sup['rules'][r['id']]['fired_L1']}" for r in rules) + f"; union {sup['union_fired_L1']}; no-op comparisons {len(sup['no_op_comparisons'])}")
240	    rows = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask); rows0 = np.flatnonzero(T0.is_mask)
241	    R = np.stack([rule_fires(T.F, r) for r in rules])            # rules x all rows (IS + OOS; only IS rows are ever scored)
242	    R0 = np.stack([rule_fires(T0.F, r) for r in rules])
243	    per, vecs, ledger_ids = [], [], []
244	    for j, r in enumerate(rules):
245	        fires, fires0 = R[j], R0[j]
246	        ns = int(fires[rows].sum())
247	        untestable = ns <= 1
248	        cfg = dict(round=0, rule=r["id"], **{"if": r["if"]}, then="skip", sha256_rules=REGISTERED_SHA[:16])
249	        res = H.score(T, ~fires, FAMILY, cfg, script=__file__, note=NOTE)
250	        res0 = H.score(T0, ~fires0, FAMILY, cfg, script=__file__, note=NOTE)
251	        vec = H.session_vectors(T, ~fires, rows); vecs.append(vec); ledger_ids.append(res["id"])
252	        boot = H.bootstrap_ci(vec, tag=f"{tf}|{r['id']}") if not untestable else None
253	        blocks = block_table(T, fires, rows)
254	        log(f"[{tf}] {r['id']:6s} skipped {res['skipped_n']:5d} kept {res['kept_n']:5d} diff {res['diff']} ctrl {res['control_pct']} perm_p {res['perm_p']} "
255	            f"loserR {res['loser_recall']} winR(w) {res['winner_recall_weighted']} topdec_skipped {res['top_decile_winners_skipped']} | L0 diff {res0['diff']} ctrl {res0['control_pct']}"
256	            + ("  << UNTESTABLE (no IS support)" if untestable else ""))
257	        per.append(dict(id=r["id"], rule=r["if"], reason=r["reason"], expected=r["expected"], untestable=untestable,
258	                        support_note=(f"no IS support: skipped_n = {ns} on the L1 table ({sup['rules'][r['id']]['fired_L0']} of {sup['is_setups_L0']} IS SETUPs); no diff, control percentile or permutation p can be computed" if untestable else None),
259	                        L1=res, L0=res0, boot=boot, blocks=blocks))
260	    # union of the 8 rules (pre-registered)
261	    U, U0 = R.any(axis=0), R0.any(axis=0)
262	    cfg_u = dict(round=0, rule="union_all8", members=[r["id"] for r in rules], then="skip", sha256_rules=REGISTERED_SHA[:16])
263	    res_u = H.score(T, ~U, FAMILY, cfg_u, script=__file__, note=NOTE); res_u0 = H.score(T0, ~U0, FAMILY, cfg_u, script=__file__, note=NOTE)
264	    vec_u = H.session_vectors(T, ~U, rows); boot_u = H.bootstrap_ci(vec_u, tag=f"{tf}|union")
265	    log(f"[{tf}] union  skipped {res_u['skipped_n']} kept {res_u['kept_n']} diff {res_u['diff']} ctrl {res_u['control_pct']} perm_p {res_u['perm_p']} loserR {res_u['loser_recall']} winR(w) {res_u['winner_recall_weighted']} | L0 diff {res_u0['diff']} ctrl {res_u0['control_pct']}")
266	    # multiplicity
267	    mt = max_t(T.net[rows], R[:, rows], tag=f"{tf}|L1")
268	    fam_vecs = vecs + [vec_u]
269	    pbo_diff, pbo_km = H.pbo(fam_vecs, "diff"), H.pbo(fam_vecs, "kept_mean")
270	    spa_ = H.spa(fam_vecs, tag=f"{tf}|llm_round0"); eff = H.effective_trials(fam_vecs)
271	    srs = []
272	    for v in fam_vecs:
273	        x = kept_session_series(v); srs.append(float(x.mean() / x.std(ddof=1)) if len(x) > 2 and x.std(ddof=1) > 0 else np.nan)

275	    dsrs = [H.deflated_sharpe(kept_session_series(v), N_TRIALS_ROUND, sr_var if sr_var and sr_var > 0 else None) for v in fam_vecs]
276	    log(f"[{tf}] max-T: best |t| {mt['best_abs_t']} (rule {rules[mt['best_rule_index']]['id']}), family-wise p {mt['familywise_p_best']}, null 95th pct of max|t| {mt['maxt_null_p95']}; PBO(diff) {pbo_diff['pbo']} PBO(kept_mean) {pbo_km['pbo']}; SPA p {spa_['spa_p']} (RC p {spa_['rc_p']}); effective trials {eff}")
277	    # go / no-go per rule and for the union (no cpcv item: a fixed rule has no fitted threshold)
278	    gng = {}
279	    for j, p in enumerate(per):
280	        ok, ch = H.go_no_go(p["L1"], tf, cpcv=None, pbo_value=pbo_diff["pbo"], dsr=dsrs[j], spa_p=spa_["spa_p"], boot=p["boot"]) if not p["untestable"] else (False, {"untestable": (False, "no IS support")})
281	        p["go_no_go"] = dict(passed=bool(ok), checks={k: [bool(v[0]), v[1]] for k, v in ch.items()}, cpcv="not applicable: fixed rule, no fitted threshold"); p["dsr"] = dsrs[j]
282	        p["maxt_t"] = mt["t_obs"][j]; p["maxt_adjusted_p"] = mt["adjusted_p"][j]; gng[p["id"]] = bool(ok)
283	    ok_u, ch_u = H.go_no_go(res_u, tf, cpcv=None, pbo_value=pbo_diff["pbo"], dsr=dsrs[-1], spa_p=spa_["spa_p"], boot=boot_u)
284	    union = dict(L1=res_u, L0=res_u0, boot=boot_u, blocks=block_table(T, U, rows), dsr=dsrs[-1],
285	                 go_no_go=dict(passed=bool(ok_u), checks={k: [bool(v[0]), v[1]] for k, v in ch_u.items()}, cpcv="not applicable: fixed rule list, no fitted threshold"))
286	    log(f"[{tf}] go/no-go: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {'PASS' if v else 'fail'}" for k, v in gng.items()) + f", union {'PASS' if ok_u else 'fail'}")
287	    results["timeframes"][tf] = dict(n_is_L1=int(T.is_mask.sum()), n_is_L0=int(T0.is_mask.sum()), all_mean_L1=round(float(T.net[rows].mean()), 2), all_mean_L0=round(float(T0.net[rows0].mean()), 2),
288	                                     rules=per, union=union, max_t=mt, pbo_diff=pbo_diff, pbo_kept_mean=pbo_km, spa=spa_, effective_trials=eff,
289	                                     sharpe_family=[None if not np.isfinite(s) else round(s, 4) for s in srs], sharpe_var_family=sr_var,
290	                                     support=sup, runtime_s=round(time.time() - t0, 1))
291	    return T, R, per, res_u

294	def combination(tf, T, R, per, rules, results):
295	    """Design step 4 (pre-specified): rules with Holm p < 0.05 (m = 16 over the round) and control pct >= 95, greedily combined in
296	    order of diff; stop when the marginal diff < 200 INR/trade or the |net|-weighted winner recall falls. Every step is a ledger row."""
297	    rows = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
298	    elig = [j for j, p in enumerate(per) if not p["untestable"] and p["holm_p_round"] < COMBO_HOLM_ALPHA and (p["L1"]["control_pct"] or 0) >= COMBO_CONTROL_MIN]
299	    out = dict(eligible=[per[j]["id"] for j in elig], steps=[], final=None,
300	               rule=f"Holm p (m={HOLM_M}) < {COMBO_HOLM_ALPHA} and control pct >= {COMBO_CONTROL_MIN}; greedy by diff; stop when marginal diff < {COMBO_MIN_GAIN} or |net|-weighted winner recall falls")
301	    if not elig:
302	        out["final"] = "no rule qualifies; no combination scored"; log(f"[{tf}] combination: no rule qualifies"); results["timeframes"][tf]["combination"] = out; return
303	    elig.sort(key=lambda j: -(per[j]["L1"]["diff"] or -1e9))
304	    chosen, cur, prev_res = [], np.zeros(T.n, dtype=bool), None
305	    for j in elig:
306	        cand = cur | R[j]; cfg = dict(round=0, rule="combo", members=[per[i]["id"] for i in chosen + [j]], then="skip", sha256_rules=REGISTERED_SHA[:16])
307	        res = H.score(T, ~cand, FAMILY_COMBO, cfg, script=__file__, note=NOTE)
308	        step = dict(added=per[j]["id"], id=res["id"], kept_n=res["kept_n"], diff=res["diff"], control_pct=res["control_pct"], winner_recall_weighted=res["winner_recall_weighted"])
309	        if prev_res is not None:
310	            marginal = (res["diff"] or 0) - (prev_res["diff"] or 0)
311	            step["marginal_diff"] = round(marginal, 2)
312	            if marginal < COMBO_MIN_GAIN or (res["winner_recall_weighted"] or 0) < (prev_res["winner_recall_weighted"] or 0):
313	                step["accepted"] = False; out["steps"].append(step); log(f"[{tf}] combination: stop before {per[j]['id']} (marginal {marginal:.1f})"); break
314	        step["accepted"] = True; out["steps"].append(step); chosen.append(j); cur = cand; prev_res = res
315	        log(f"[{tf}] combination: + {per[j]['id']} -> kept {res['kept_n']} diff {res['diff']} ctrl {res['control_pct']}")
316	    out["final"] = dict(members=[per[i]["id"] for i in chosen], ledger_id=prev_res["id"] if prev_res else None, L1=prev_res)
317	    results["timeframes"][tf]["combination"] = out

content.subject: Install the program's Python packages (shap, hmmlearn, mapie, arch, torch, psutil) and verify imports
content.description: numpy pandas pyarrow scipy scikit-learn xgboost shap numba matplotlib joblib torch statsmodels hmmlearn mapie ruptures arch stumpy; verify every import; note versions (pandas 3.x vs local 2.3.3) in fz_v3/out/QUALITY.md

content.subject: Rebuild both datasets (1m, 5m) from fz_v3/data via engine.load; cross-check against fz_v3/built; write QUALITY.md
content.description: One build script per timeframe under fz_v3/out/build/: engine.run (ST1 rules on 1m, ST2 on 5m), Foundation trades priced (lot 65, 5 pts slip, ZERODHA_NFO_FUT), fz.run with ST7/ST8 blocks, per-SETUP feature table with the same column contract as built/, plus the L1 intraday 15:25 label, the truncation causality check. Compare SETUP counts, trades, room card against fz_v3/built; the cloud rebuild wins; log discrepancies in fz_v3/out/QUALITY.md.

content.subject: Validation harness: splitter (12 IS blocks, purge by label exit, 3-session embargo), CPCV paths, append-only ledger via score(), PBO, DSR, block bootstrap, SPA
content.description: fz_v3/out/harness.py: the single evaluator. Every gate candidate goes through score(); kept-vs-skipped expectancy, session-matched random control (fz_report.random_control), permutation p (fz_report.permutation_p), CPCV 11 paths, go/no-go rule (PBO <= 0.2, CPCV p5 diff > 0, DSR p < 0.1, kept share >= 20%, kept n >= 300/80, top-1%-removed value > 0, slippage 8 pts survival). Break tests (BDE CUSUM, Chow) as pre-registration.

content.subject: Feature vocabulary pass: clustered MDA/MDI/SFI, FFD, BSADF/CUSUM, BOCPD run length, novelty scalars, SHAP interactions; freeze <= 8 clusters
content.description: quant-ml-canon-feature-importance merged with the feature contributions of regime-breaks, regime-states (BOCPD, GMM), motif (nn_dist_prefix, p1_dist_prefix), rocket window summaries. Per-year stability filter. Shortlist frozen in the ledger before any gate search.

content.subject: H1-H5 classical studies through the harness (gate audit, regime, volume, levels, learned gate) on IS
content.description: H1 what ST7/ST8 skip (precision/recall as loser filter, big winners); H2 regime grid; H3 visibly-high-volume reaction; H4 level respect vs break; H5 depth-3 tree + greedy rule list + GBM ceiling. All IS, via score(), every trial in the ledger.

content.subject: Learned-gate family: meta-labelling + full-information policy tree, distilled to rule list / scorecard; regime states; LLM hypotheses (round 0 blind, round 1 cross-fitted); FQI exit; session stop; conformal operating point; sizing
content.description: DESIGN_PANEL merged program: meta-label gate (L1 label, winsorised |net| weights, HGB/bagging ceilings, scorecard, rule list), policy trees, GMM/HMM/BOCPD regime states, LLM-hypothesis rounds with family-wise max-T permutation, FQI exit policy (learner C grid, B hindsight imitation, A FQI), session stop rule with within-session x hour null, conformal skip operating point, sizing conditional on a surviving gate, null tapes (5m), adversarial drift.
content.activeForm: Running the learned-gate family and modern-ML studies

content.subject: Walk-forward learn-after-each-trade policy with the trade journal (IS learning curve, continued through OOS); compose with rl.py for exit/size
content.description: fz_learn.py prototype: journal rows per SETUP (features, decision, reason, model state id, fill, exit, MFE/MAE, pts, gross, costs, net, R, running equity/DD/PF); online learners (LinUCB/Thompson on logistic or tree-embedded model, online GBM refits, k-trade cadence); fractional Kelly sizing with max lots and daily loss stop; learning curve vs take-all and random control; deterministic replay.

content.subject: OOS opened once by one script for at most three frozen candidates (rule list, learner, ST7/ST8 comparator)
content.description: fz_v3/out/oos_once.py reads frozen candidate JSON + sha; scores OOS 2026-01-01..2026-09-25 with random control, permutation p, kept-vs-skipped, winner recall; the learner continues updating through OOS as it would live. Caveats: OOS window = published lab window, used by ST9-12 exit grid.

content.subject: Report survivors and plan to the user before creating strategy files; then code ST13/ST14 (fz_learn.py, strategy_13/14.json, tests, docs, S49, REPORT.md)
content.description: Tell the user the plan and survivors first. Then: fz_learn.py beside fz.py (entry_rule fz_v3), strategy_13.json / strategy_14.json with every threshold / weight / hyper-parameter as a sourced key, journal as an output table, deterministic replay, engine.py untouched, ST5-ST8 bit-for-bit unchanged; extend tests/test_fz_parity.py and tests/test_truncation.py; FZ.md, README.md, S49 (Rule 0), fz_v3/out/REPORT.md, QUALITY.md.

content.subject: rocket_ceiling: benchmark, write rocket_ceiling.py, run under nohup, write FINDINGS.md + findings.json
content.description: Study rocket_ceiling under OUT/studies/rocket_ceiling: window tensor (L=60, 7 channels), 2,000 MiniRocket-style kernels, fold-fitted biases, L2 logistic probe with nested GroupKFold alpha, comparators (tabular HGB, PCA-16 window probe, stacked HGB), 12 purged splits + 66 CPCV splits -> 11 paths, AUC gain distribution, pre-registered stop at CPCV p5 gain < 0.03, gates at skip 30/50/70% as ledger rows (rocket/<model>), truncation check of the window tensor, timing + RSS, FINDINGS.md and findings.json.

285	def session_vectors(T, keep, rows):
286	    """Per active session (sessions with a unit among rows): kept sum / n, skipped sum / n, all sum / n."""
287	    keep = np.asarray(keep, dtype=bool)
288	    ses = T.session[rows]; net = T.net[rows]; kp = keep[rows]
289	    S = np.array(sorted(set(ses.tolist())))
290	    idx = np.searchsorted(S, ses)
291	    out = {}
292	    for name, msk in (("kept", kp), ("skipped", ~kp), ("all", np.ones(len(rows), dtype=bool))):
293	        out[name + "_sum"] = np.bincount(idx, weights=net * msk, minlength=len(S))
294	        out[name + "_n"] = np.bincount(idx, weights=msk.astype(float), minlength=len(S))
295	    out["sessions"] = S
296	    return out

366	def pbo(vectors, statistic="kept_mean", S=CSCV_S):
367	    """CSCV probability of backtest overfitting (Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado & Zhu 2017) over a family of candidates.
368	    vectors: list of session_vectors dicts (one per candidate, same sessions). Each candidate's per-session series is split into
369	    S contiguous blocks; for every C(S, S/2) partition the IS-best candidate's OOS rank is recorded; PBO = share of partitions
370	    where that rank is below the median (logit < 0). statistic: 'kept_mean' = kept net per kept trade over the half, or 'diff'
371	    = kept mean minus skipped mean over the half. Also the IS-vs-OOS performance degradation slope and the share of partitions
372	    where the IS-best is below zero OOS."""
373	    M = len(vectors)
374	    if M < 2: return dict(candidates=M, pbo=None, note="needs at least 2 candidates")
375	    T_ = len(vectors[0]["sessions"]); edges = np.linspace(0, T_, S + 1).round().astype(int)
376	    def blocks(v, key):
377	        return np.array([v[key][edges[b]:edges[b + 1]].sum() for b in range(S)])
378	    KS = np.array([blocks(v, "kept_sum") for v in vectors]); KN = np.array([blocks(v, "kept_n") for v in vectors])
379	    SS = np.array([blocks(v, "skipped_sum") for v in vectors]); SN = np.array([blocks(v, "skipped_n") for v in vectors])
380	    P = _partitions(S).astype(float)                                           # partitions x S
381	    def perf(Pm):
382	        ks, kn = Pm @ KS.T, Pm @ KN.T                                           # partitions x M
383	        with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
384	            km = np.where(kn > 0, ks / kn, np.nan)
385	            if statistic == "kept_mean": return km
386	            ss, sn = Pm @ SS.T, Pm @ SN.T
387	            return km - np.where(sn > 0, ss / sn, np.nan)
388	    ins, oos = perf(P), perf(1 - P)
389	    ins = np.where(np.isnan(ins), -np.inf, ins)
390	    best = np.argmax(ins, axis=1)
391	    oos_best = oos[np.arange(len(P)), best]
392	    ranks = np.array([(np.nan_to_num(oos[i], nan=-np.inf) < oos_best[i]).sum() / (M - 1) if M > 1 else 0.5 for i in range(len(P))])
393	    ranks = np.clip(ranks, 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6)
394	    logit = np.log(ranks / (1 - ranks))
395	    ins_best = ins[np.arange(len(P)), best]
396	    ok = np.isfinite(oos_best) & np.isfinite(ins_best)
397	    slope = float(np.polyfit(ins_best[ok], oos_best[ok], 1)[0]) if ok.sum() > 2 else None
398	    return dict(candidates=M, partitions=int(len(P)), statistic=statistic, pbo=round(float((logit < 0).mean()), 4),
399	                oos_best_below_zero=round(float((oos_best[ok] < 0).mean()), 4) if ok.any() else None,
400	                degradation_slope=round(slope, 4) if slope is not None else None,
401	                is_best_mean=round(float(ins_best[ok].mean()), 2) if ok.any() else None,
402	                oos_best_mean=round(float(oos_best[ok].mean()), 2) if ok.any() else None)

405	def effective_trials(vectors, key="kept_sum"):
406	    """Participation-ratio count of independent trials from the correlation matrix of the candidates' per-session series."""
407	    X = np.array([v[key] for v in vectors], dtype=float)
408	    X = X[:, X.std(axis=0) > 0] if X.shape[0] > 1 else X
409	    if X.shape[0] < 2: return float(X.shape[0])
410	    C = np.corrcoef(X); C = np.nan_to_num(C, nan=0.0); np.fill_diagonal(C, 1.0)
411	    lam = np.clip(np.linalg.eigvalsh(C), 0, None)
412	    return round(float(lam.sum() ** 2 / (lam ** 2).sum()), 2)

Two live rooms never overlap (a shared edge is allowed). A sit that overlaps live rooms by less than `merge_overlap` is a new room, and `room_overlap` says how the overlap is removed: **`supersede`** (seeded): the new room keeps its full width and the rooms it overlaps are retired on its birth bar (`retired_by = superseded`); `clip`: the new room's edges stop at the neighbours' edges. Visit numbers are as-of: the current stay counts as a visit while it lasts. The first visit (`first_bars`, `first_vol`) and the previous visit (`volume_base = previous`, `prev_bars`) are the first / previous stay that is not a touch. With `visit_min_bars = 1` no stay can be a touch (a stay opens on an inside close), which is how the base stays unchanged.

143	## 7. The card
144	
145	One row per bar, computed as of that bar and never rewritten. Fields: `zone_id` (the ref band), `visit_n`, `this_bars`, `this_vol`, `vol_na`, `first_bars`, `first_vol`, `first_vol_na`, `read`, `left_id` (the band whose LEAVE is live), `out_run`, `out_side`, `session_bar`, `gap_pts`, `wick_depth`, `last_hunt_at/dir`, `last_reject_at/dir`, `cluster_sit`, `prev_bars`, `prev_vol`, `last_leave_failed`, `in_id` (the band containing the close, nearest mid), `leave_side`, `leave_vol_ok`, `leave_kind`, `first_clock_lived`.
146	
147	**Read precedence.** LEAVE (a LEAVE is live on `left_id`) → HUNT → REJECT → the inside read of the ref band's visit when the close is inside it → PENDING (the close is outside the ref band, visit still live) → NEW (no ref band).
148	
149	**Inside reads.** Visit 1 reads FIRST_PRINT (`first_clock_lived` says whether it has lasted `accept_bars`). On a revisit, with B = the base visit (`volume_base`: the first visit, or the previous one): ACCEPTED when `this_bars ≥ accept_bars` and (volume is NA on either side, or `this_vol ≥ accept_vol_ratio × B.vol`); else THIN when volume is live and `this_vol < thin_ratio × B.vol`; else RECYCLE.
150	
151	**Volume NA.** A bar is NA when its session is not the front month (`front_month == 0` in the 1-minute file) or its volume is 0. A visit is NA if any of its bars is; the first visit's NA flag never changes. NA makes ACCEPTED time-only, THIN unavailable, the HUNT burst skipped and R4 skipped. Because `fm_na` folds the front-month flag in, two visits with live volume are always in the same volume regime, so a cross-regime ratio cannot be computed by construction.
152	
153	`leave_vol_ok` (the R4 of a LEAVE read): per-bar mean volume of the far-side closes since R1 ≥ the sit's per-bar mean; `null` when either side is NA; re-evaluated on every far-side bar.
154	
155	---
156	
157	## 8. The gate at a Foundation SETUP
158	
159	Evaluated on the SETUP bar k with direction S, after the watch step of that bar. The ledger row is created first with the card's columns; on a LEAVE read it also records the entered band (`entered_zone_id`, `entered_visit_n`, `entered_read` = that band's read as if it were the ref band).
160	
161	1. **A REENTER already decided on this bar** by the watch step (R5 satisfied on the SETUP bar itself) makes the row `REENTER` with branch `watch`.
162	2. **Hard BLOCK**, in this order, no watch opened and any existing watch untouched: `in_position` (an FZ position is open on this bar), `clock` (bar open time ≥ `no_entry_from`), `open_pierce` (within the session's first `open_bars` bars and before `open_window_until`, the bar's range crosses an edge of a band whose last visit ended in an earlier session and that has fewer than `open_sit_closes` closes inside today), `hunt_fade` (the latest HUNT of the ref band or of the band just left, or of any band under `fade_scope = any_band`, is in S's direction, completed within `fade_block_bars`, same session), `new` (the read is NEW).
163	3. **TAKE branches**, the first that holds:
164	   - **leave**: read LEAVE, S equals the leave side, `leave_vol_ok` is not False, not a gap LEAVE inside the first `open_quiet_bars` bars, and `leave_far_side`: `any` accepts; `block_list` refuses when the entered band reads RECYCLE, THIN, HUNT or REJECT (`block_reason = leave_into_recycle`); `no_band` refuses whenever a band contains the close (`leave_into_band`). A refusal records `take_why` and falls through to WATCH.
165	   - **first_print**: read FIRST_PRINT, the visit is at least `first_print_min_bars` old, S equals the visit's `entry_dir`.
166	   - **defend**: read ACCEPTED and the ref band's latest HUNT or latest REJECT (one slot each, §6) fell in this visit, within `defend_window_bars`, at the edge S points away from.
167	   - A **leave** TAKE of the band a watch waits on, in the watch's direction, is that watch's REENTER instead (branch `leave`, `reenter_reason = take_on_watch:leave`); a first_print or defend TAKE stays Foundation's own position and leaves the watch as it is.
168	   - A TAKE calls `open_position('TAKE')`; the engine may have skipped the SETUP for a wrong-side stop, in which case the row records `refused` and no position opens. An opposite-direction TAKE ends an open watch (`opposite_take`). A converted (branch-1) REENTER that the callback refuses keeps `gate = REENTER` with `refused` set and no position, and its `outcome_gate` is then REENTER too; this has not occurred on the tape (0 rows in all four strategies), and what it should become is open (S44 b).
169	4. **WATCH_EDGE**: `edge_watch = ref_band`, the read is PENDING, the previous close was inside the ref band and S is the side the close is on: a watch on the ref band that is already armed (this bar is R1).
170	5. **WATCH**: a band contains the close: a watch on that band with `dir = S`, not armed.
171	6. **BLOCK `new`** otherwise.
172	
173	One watch at a time: a later SETUP that opens a watch replaces the current one (`outcome = replaced`); a BLOCKed SETUP leaves it untouched. `gate` on the row is the decision as of the SETUP bar (what the truncation test compares); `outcome_gate` is how the SETUP ended (REENTER when a later REENTER used this SETUP as its R5), and the tables and headline counts use `outcome_gate`.
174	
175	---
176	
177	## 9. The watch machine
178	
179	A watch pins a snapshot of its band (edges, mid, the sit's per-bar mean volume) and runs once per bar before the gate, from the bar after it opened.
180	
181	- **Cancels**, checked first: the first bar of a new session (`session_end`); `leave_closes` consecutive closes beyond the band on the side opposite to the watch direction (`opposite_leave`); from ARMED, `cancel_inside_bars` consecutive closes back inside (`back_inside`). An opposite TAKE cancels from the gate (`opposite_take`).
182	- **R1**: a close beyond the band on the watch's side arms the watch (`armed_at`; `first_armed_at` on the first arming). A close back inside breaks the far-side run; the next far-side close arms again (R1 again), so R3 (no close inside or across the mid since R1) holds by construction on the unbroken run. The ledger reports both `armed_bars` (from the first arming) and `rearmed_bars` (from the latest).
183	- **R2**: `leave_closes` consecutive far-side closes. **R4**: per-bar mean volume of the far-side run ≥ the pinned sit mean, skipped (None) when the run or the sit is volume-NA. `r4_bars_evaluated / fail / na` are counted per window.
184	- **R5**: a Foundation SETUP in the watch direction on this bar or on the previous bar of the same session.
185	- **REENTER** on the first bar j where R1–R5 hold, unless the bar's open time is at or past `no_entry_from` (`clock_1520` counted, watch stays armed) or a position is open (`reenter_in_position`). The callback prices nothing back; it may refuse (`wrong_side_stop`, `sl_dead_at_fill`), counted as `reenter_refused`, the watch continues. On success the row of the R5 SETUP gets `fill_bar`, `fill_used` (`setup_close` when j is the SETUP bar, else `reenter_close`), `fill_delay_bars`, `edge_dist_pts`, `armed_bars`, `rearmed_bars`, `reenter_reason` and `outcome_gate = REENTER`.
186	- **Outcomes** in the watch log: `reenter`, `replaced`, `cancelled:<reason>` (never armed) or `armed_expired:<reason>` (armed), `active` at the data end. `no_same_dir_setup` counts armed watches that expired with R1–R4 satisfied on their last bar.
187	
188	Position lifetime is entry bar ≤ k < exit bar, so a SETUP on a position's exit bar may open a new one at that bar's close; `build_trades` asserts that no two FZ positions overlap under that convention.
189	
190	---
191	
192	## 10. Execution: `fz_exec.py`
193	
194	- `view(r)`: the frozen view: swings as (kind, bar, price, conf), setups as (bar, dir, CHoCH bar), CHoCHs as (bar, dir, level), the protected level per bar. Nothing final-state.
195	- `stops(bars, swings, sl_rule)`: the Foundation stop rule at any bar: `prev_swing` = the latest confirmed swing low (long) or high (short) with conf ≤ bar; `choch_candle` = the CHoCH candle's low/high.
196	- `refusal(...)`: `wrong_side_stop` (the engine's own skip: the stop is not on the loss side of the entry close) and, for REENTER, `sl_dead_at_fill` (the entry candle already traded through the stop).
197	- `simulate(bars, entry, dir, sl, chi, touch, band, choch, dead)`: the engine's trade loop restated statement for statement: exit at the stop on any later candle (touch mode: the worse of the candle open and the stop; a session's first candle: its close; close mode: the close), else at the close of the first CHoCH after the entry, else open at the last candle. With a band (REENTER), a close on the band side of the band's mid (long: below it; short: above it) exits at that close with reason `band_reclaim`, checked after the stop and before the CHoCH exit on the same candle.
198	- `opener(...)`: the `open_position` callback. TAKE returns the engine trade's exit bar for that SETUP (or `wrong_side_stop` when the engine skipped it). REENTER evaluates the stop rule at the fill bar, refuses if needed, else runs `simulate()` and returns its exit bar.
199	- `build_trades(...)`: the FZ trade list in engine shape, sorted by entry. TAKE rows are the engine's trade dicts copied and annotated (`gate`, `zone_id`, `fill_used`, `reenter_reason`); REENTER rows come from `simulate()` at the fill bar with `setup_i`, `sl_bar` (`setup` when the stop at the fill bar equals the SETUP-bar stop, else `fill`) and `sl_in_band`. It asserts that `fz.run` and `simulate()` agree on every REENTER and that positions do not overlap.
200	
201	`tests/test_fz_parity.py` runs `simulate()` on every Foundation SETUP with the engine's own stop and requires every Foundation trade back field for field (207 of 207 on 1 min, 73 of 73 on 5 min) before any REENTER row is trusted.
202

# Independent max-T reproduction (IS rows only, L1) with a different seed; no ledger writes, no new configuration.
import sys, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0,"."); import harness as H
sys.path.insert(0,"studies/llm_hypotheses")
from score_round0 import rule_fires, welch_t   # reuse the mask semantics exactly
rules=json.load(open("studies/llm_hypotheses/rules_round0.json"))
for tf in ("minute","5minute"):
    T=H.load(tf); rows=np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask); net=T.net[rows]
    R=np.stack([rule_fires(T.F,r) for r in rules[tf]])[:,rows]
    obs=np.array([welch_t(net,R[j]) for j in range(R.shape[0])]); ok=np.isfinite(obs)
    rng=np.random.default_rng(20260929)
    Rk=(~R[ok]).astype(float); Rs=R[ok].astype(float); nk,ns=Rk.sum(1),Rs.sum(1)
    mx=np.empty(2000)
    for d in range(2000):
        p=net[rng.permutation(len(net))]
        sk,ss=Rk@p,Rs@p; qk,qs=Rk@(p*p),Rs@(p*p); mk,ms=sk/nk,ss/ns
        vk=(qk-nk*mk*mk)/(nk-1); vs=(qs-ns*ms*ms)/(ns-1)
        mx[d]=np.abs((mk-ms)/np.sqrt(vk/nk+vs/ns)).max()
    a=np.abs(obs[ok]); best=int(np.argmax(a))
    fw=(1+(mx>=a[best]-1e-12).sum())/2001
    print(f"{tf}: testable {int(ok.sum())} of {len(obs)}; t_obs {np.round(obs,3).tolist()}; best |t| {a[best]:.3f} (rule {rules[tf][np.flatnonzero(ok)[best]]['id']}); family-wise p {fw:.4f}; null p95 of max|t| {np.quantile(mx,0.95):.3f}")
    # Holm m=16 check
raw=[0.9605,0.9525,0.9745,0.5222,0.8041,0.5752,0.8751,1.0,0.1689,0.0625,0.8481,0.2229,0.3963,0.7616,0.8146,0.3633]
p=np.array(raw); o=np.argsort(p); adj=np.empty(16); prev=0
for i,j in enumerate(o): v=min(1,(16-i)*p[j]); prev=max(prev,v); adj[j]=prev
print("Holm m=16 adjusted:", adj.tolist(), "| with untestable m6,f8 forced to 1:", end=" ")
p2=p.copy(); p2[5]=1; p2[15]=1; o=np.argsort(p2); adj2=np.empty(16); prev=0
for i,j in enumerate(o): v=min(1,(16-i)*p2[j]); prev=max(prev,v); adj2[j]=prev
print(adj2.min())
EOF

The r0_m6 and r0_f8 ledger rows (one skipped trade each) carry diff 725.46 / 2,897.90, control pct 65.5 / 87.6 and perm_p 0.5752 / 0.3633, those values are printed in the section-4 tables, and the Holm raw-p list uses 0.5752 and 0.3633 for them (the code maps only None to 1.0). Conclusions are unchanged: Holm adjusted p is 1.0 for all 16 either way (min raw p 0.0625 x 16 = 1.0; recomputed with m6/f8 forced to 1: still 1.0).
issues.evidence: ledger rows 7e2e3b02928d00c0 (r0_m6 L1: skipped 1, diff 725.46, ctrl 65.5, perm_p 0.5752) and af6b26dbc455e8f7 (r0_f8 L1: skipped 1, diff 2897.9, ctrl 87.6, perm_p 0.3633); 5645244e4b0400db (r0_m8: skipped 0, diff None). round0_results.json holm.raw_p = [..., 0.5752 (m6), ..., 1.0 (m8), ..., 0.3633 (f8)]; holm_p all 1.0.
issues.fix: In FINDINGS.md sections 0, 6 and 12 (and the score_round0.py docstring) say: 'r0_m8 carries no statistic; r0_m6 and r0_f8 carry a single-trade diff / control / perm_p that is reported but not interpretable, and enter Holm with their harness perm_p (0.5752, 0.3633); forcing them to p = 1 leaves every adjusted p at 1.0'. No ledger or hashed file changes.
